hero-lede2:
We think AI is a tool for people — and people should not be tools for AI.

So this site looks at the other side of AI: augmented intelligence. The idea is almost as old as AI itself, but people talk about it far less.

It means using AI to reach the many tools and all the data that are already out there, and to make them easier to understand — so you can do more.
